title: STIs (Sexually Transmitted Infections)
summary: STIs are infections passed through sexual contact — vaginal, anal or oral sex and sometimes skin-to-skin contact. Common ones include chlamydia, gonorrhoea, syphilis, herpes, HPV, trichomoniasis and HIV.
key_points: Many STIs have no symptoms, so testing is the only way to know.
Most are treatable and many are curable; all are manageable.
Condoms, vaccines (HPV, hepatitis B), testing and PrEP lower risk.
answer_guidance: Be non-judgemental — STIs are health issues, not moral failings. Encourage testing without alarming.
